=== WebUI /health ===
{"status":true} [HTTP 200]
=== WebUI / ===

=== Container health states ===

(end)

observation.command: echo "=== WebUI /health ==="; curl -s -w " [HTTP %{http_code}]\n" http://localhost:3333/health; echo "=== WebUI / ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}, %{size_download} bytes\n" http://localhost:3333/; echo "=== Container health states ==="; for c in ipfs0 workspace-webui-1; do echo -n "$c: "; docker inspect --format '{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none{{end}}' $c; done; echo "=== Any unhealthy/exited ==="; docker ps -a --filter "health=unhealthy" --filter "status=exited" --format "{{.Names}}: {{.Status}}"; echo "(end)"
